Avani Singh
Having served as president of Comet Investing Group and as chief executive officer at
several prestigious financial firms in New Zealand, Avani Singh now dedicates her time
to public speaking. Drawing on her extensive experience, Ms. Singh provides expert
guidance to help businesses become more forward thinking and achieve consistent
growth in changing times.
Sampling of recent speeches
¢ Sustaining Imagination (Makey School of Business)
¢ Overcoming Financial Obstacles (Wellington Entrepreneurs Society)
¢ The Future of Finance (International Investment Banking Convention)

jhays@avanisingh.co.nz.

Subject: _| [ City Business Expo ]
Dear Ms. Hays,
I saw Avani Singh present at Makey School of Business last year and was impressed by
her powerful message. I believe Ms. Singh would be an ideal keynote speaker for the next
annual City Business Expo, particularly since the expo theme is Corporate Creativity and
Innovation.
The expo will take place from 7 to 10 March at the Auckland Convention Hall. We would
like the keynote speaker to present on the first day of the expo; however, the schedule is
fairly open, and we would be happy to have Ms. Singh give a speech at any time during the
expo that suits her schedule.
Would you kindly share her availability as well as her fee for this type of keynote address?
Regards,
Landon Beaumont

context.passage_translation:
qj > [ http://mww.avanisingh.co.nz |
Avani Singh
曾担任彗星投资集团（Comet Investing Group）总裁，并在新西兰多家著名的金融公司担任首席执行官的阿瓦尼·辛格（Avani Singh），现在将她的时间投入到公开演讲。凭借她丰富的经验，辛格女士为帮助企业在变化的环境中变得更具前瞻性并实现持续增长提供专家指导。
近期演讲摘录
¢ 维持想象力 (Makey 商学院)
¢ 克服财务障碍 (惠灵顿企业家协会)
¢ 金融的未来 (国际投资银行大会)
° 如何成为一个充满活力的领导者 (NFI 基金会)
如需辛格女士的简历、空档期和费用，请联系 Julia Hays，jhays@avanisingh.co.nz。
收件人: | | jhays @avanisingh.co.nz |
发件人: | | landon@cbe.co.nz
日期: | [ 8月19日
主题: _| [ 市商业博览会 ]
尊敬的海斯女士：
我去年在 Makey 商学院看到阿瓦尼·辛格做演讲，并对她强有力的信息印象深刻。我相信辛格女士将是下一次年度市商业博览会的理想主旨演讲嘉宾，特别是考虑到本次博览会的主题是企业创造力和创新。
博览会将于 3 月 7 日至 10 日在奥克兰会议中心举行。我们希望主旨演讲嘉宾能在博览会第一天进行演讲；然而，日程安排比较灵活，如果能让辛格女士在任何符合她时间表的时间进行演讲，我们将不胜感激。
您能否告知她的空档期以及这次主旨演讲的费用？
此致，
Landon Beaumont
市商业博览会组织者

辛格女士的演讲极具启发性！她使用个人轶事来阐述观点，使内容引人入胜、清晰且令人难忘。
3. 请评价您对本次博览会的满意度。

会议中心不适合这次活动；工作坊房间太小，而且食物摊贩不够——排队总是很长。
请将您的调查问卷放入散布在整个会议中心的收集箱中。
谢谢！
